answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 13580 Country: India Title: What is the procedure of performing Ghusl according to sunnah of the prophet Muhammed (SAW)? Question: What is the procedure of performing Ghusl according to sunnah of the prophet Muhammed (SAW)? Answer ID: 13580 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1333/1046=D/1430) One who intends ghusl should wash his hands first, then the place where there is some impurity. Thereafter, he should pour the water over his head, on his right side and then on his left side. Having cleaned the body well and removed the dirt, one should perform complete wudhu before pouring the water over body. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
